## Summary

Adds one reason for update (`reasonForUpdate`) to the identification and status section of an in-work issue. It does not touch the content and adds no change markup. Use it to write the reason of a change that has no change markup (an editorial change `urt01`, or an issue whose `issueType` is `revised` or `status`)

## Description returned by `tools/list`

This is the text an LLM receives.

> Add ONE reason for update (reasonForUpdate) to the status element of an IN-WORK data module, and nothing else: the content is not touched and no change markup is added. Use it for a change that has no change markup: an editorial change (updateReasonType urt01), or an issue whose issueType is revised or status. For a change that IS shown with change markup, do not use this tool: pass marking.reason to edit_data_module, which adds the reason and the markup together. A reason added here can be referred to by later marked edits through marking.reasonRefId (not a urt01 reason). The text and updateReasonType are the user's; nothing is filled in. Refused: a released issue (inWork "00": call start_revision first), an id already in the document. Returns added, xml (unless includeXml is false), reasonForUpdate {id, updateReasonType}, refusals[], newSchemaErrors[], verification, fixes[]. Writes only when write is true (a path is overwritten in place).

## Arguments

The content of `inputSchema`. A nested argument is written as `parent.child`, and an item of an array as `parent[].child`.

| Name | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` |  |  | File path of the document. |
| `xml` | `string` |  |  | An existing document as an XML string (alternative to path; max 5 MB). Not for XML you wrote yourself: build new data modules with build_data_module. |
| `csdbDirs` | `array<string>` |  |  | CSDB folders used to resolve references, find BREX and number new objects (default: S1000D_CSDB_DIR / the config file). The FIRST folder is also where write: true writes (it may not exist yet). When given, these folders replace S1000D_CSDB_DIR and the csdbDirs of the config file (they are not added to them); other folders that do not exist are skipped and reported in _notes. |
| `reason` | `object` | Yes |  | One reason for update (reasonForUpdate in the status element). The text and the type are the user's: never fill them in. |
| `reason.text` | `string` | Yes | length ≥ 1 | The text of the reason (one simplePara). |
| `reason.updateReasonType` | `string` | Yes | pattern `^urt[0-9]{2}$` | S1000D updateReasonType, written as given: urt01 editorial change (no change markup may refer to it), urt02 technical change, urt03 markup only, urt04 applicability only, urt05 references only; urt51-urt99 are project values. Required: it is never chosen for you. |
| `reason.updateHighlight` | `string` |  | `0` / `1` | "1": this reason goes into the Highlights data module. |
| `reason.id` | `string` |  |  | reasonForUpdate/@id. Omit it: an id that is not in the document is made (rfu-0001 …). An id already in the document is refused. |
| `product` | `object` |  |  | The product to evaluate applicability for. attributes: ACT productAttribute id → value; conditions: CCT cond id → value. Omit to skip the applicability check. |
| `product.attributes` | `object` |  |  |  |
| `product.conditions` | `object` |  |  |  |
| `write` | `boolean` |  | default `false` | Write the result into the CSDB (the first folder of csdbDirs / S1000D_CSDB_DIR). Default false: the XML is only returned. Nothing is written when the XML is not valid against the XSD unless allowInvalid is true. |
| `overwrite` | `boolean` |  | default `false` | With write: true, replace a file of the same name. Default false: an existing file is left alone and reported as write-conflict. |
| `allowInvalid` | `boolean` |  | default `false` | With write: true, write even when verification.schema.state is "invalid". Default false. |
| `includeXml` | `boolean` |  |  | Include the XML in the response (default: true when write is false, false when write is true). |
| `maxFixes` | `integer` |  | default `50`, ≥ 1, ≤ 1000 | Cap on the remaining fixes listed in the response (default 50). |
